I'm seeing a similar issues on IE11 which also requires using polyfill.io
when I use the searchFunction: function (helper) {... helper.search(); } of method of instantsearch.
I receive the following error:
Unhandled exception at line 2, column 71753 in https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/instantsearch.js@2.8.0
0x800a1391 - JavaScript runtime error: 'Promise' is undefined

This only happens with IE11.
